services.name: Our Helicopters
services.desc: Originally designed by Bell Helicopter in the early-1970s to operate efficiently in extreme heat and high altitudes, these are the largest, most powerful single engine helicopters manufactured and operated in the world. With a maximum payload of up to 3,500kg (3.5 tons) these machines are the most productive and cost effective helicopters in their class. Seating is provided for up to 14 fully equipped passengers or crew. services.desc: This is one of the most striking places on earth. There is no better way to see the glaciers, alpine valley, lakes and river systems than from the air. We offer a multitude of sightseeing options and custom packages. These are some of our most popular tours, if you are looking for a custom experience let us know and we can make suggestions. Scenic flight through the Coast Mountains to the tip of the Howe Sound and over The Chief’s 700 meter granite cliffs and Shannon Falls, the 3rd highest waterfall in B.C.
